visual.name: scorecardKpis
visual.description: The Executive Scorecard's section-3 KPI table (Drive Continuous Improvement). Renders KPI / Target / YTD Global / Trend rows styled to match the page's native tableEx tables, but the rows are hand-maintained: values live in D1 (manual_kpis) and editors update them in-place through a per-row dialog — no model backing, no refresh dependency. GUID is deliberately short: it appears TWICE in the CustomVisuals path Power BI Desktop writes on save, and a full-length form pushes this report past the 256-char Windows limit.
